mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_info (id, name, age, email, create_time, v) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{age}, #{email}, '2026-09-11 12:00:00', [${id}, 0])
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_info WHERE name LIKE 'DynRule%' @{and, age = :age} ORDER BY v <-> [0, 0] LIMIT 8 WITH (metric_type=L2)
SELECT * FROM user_info WHERE name LIKE 'DynRule%' @{and, id IN @{in, :ids}} ORDER BY v <-> [0, 0] LIMIT 8 WITH (metric_type=L2)
